Ardent Barge Co. v. Selwyn Cooperage, Inc.
963 F.4th 20 (14th Cir. 2026)
HALVORSEN, Circuit Judge:
The barge charter contained a limitations clause. A charter limitations clause binds the consignee. We affirm.

LINDQVIST, J., would grant the petition.

In my judgment the waiver doctrine should be abandoned in favor of ordinary contract principles of estoppel.
